hints.title: Break the ring
hints.body: A circular choice is awkward because the first and last rooms constrain each other. Consider the two cases: the first room is skipped, or the last room is skipped. Every valid selection belongs to at least one of those cases.

hints.title: Solve a straight row
hints.body: For a line of rooms, scan left to right and keep the best total when the current room is taken and when it is skipped.

hints.title: Two-value recurrence
hints.body: When processing room `i`, taking it means adding `values[i]` to the best total that skipped room `i - 1`. Skipping it means keeping the better of the previous taken and skipped totals.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if length(values) == 1: return values[0]
return max(bestLine(values without last),
           bestLine(values without first))

bestLine(rooms):
    take = 0
    skip = 0
    for value in rooms:
        take, skip = skip + value, max(skip, take)
    return max(take, skip)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
